## Description

Context: what we decided and why. Until an organisation is Approved it may only set itself up: profile, hours, rooms, adding staff. No patient registration, booking, check-in, notes or signing, so no patient data exists before Medvya has reviewed the organisation. The Medvya licence gate (LicenceRules) is retired by ADR-016 and this organisation gate takes its place.
What to build. Add the organisation state (Draft, Submitted, NeedsChanges, Approved, Rejected, Suspended) to the tenant and check it in IStaffAccess for every capability, replacing LicenceRules.Apply and the licencePending session flag. While not Approved the server refuses patient, booking, check-in, note, prescription and signing capabilities; settings and staff invitations work. Suspended refuses new registration, booking and signing but keeps existing records readable for care. The shell shows a plain notice per state.
Touched: Medvya.Tenancy.Domain (state on the tenant, Practice.cs), Medvya.Tenancy.Application/IStaffAccess.cs and Infrastructure/StaffAccess.cs, Host.Api/Auth/SessionControl.cs, the capability policies in Medvya.Tenancy.Api/StaffPolicies.cs, web/clinic session domain and App.tsx banner, i18n, ERD, a row-level-security-safe read of the state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an organisation that is not Approved, when any user calls a patient, booking, check-in, note, prescription or signing endpoint, then the API refuses with 403 and the attempt is audited.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a not-Approved organisation, when the owner edits profile, hours or rooms or invites staff, then it works.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the organisation becomes Approved, when the same calls are made, then they work as before.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given an organisation is Suspended, when staff open an existing record, then it is readable and new registration, booking and signing are refused.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given each state, when the shell loads, then a plain notice is shown in English and Arabic and the state is never conveyed by colour alone.

## Test notes

- Unit: capability matrix per state.
- Integration on real PostgreSQL under row-level security, mutation-checked (remove the gate and the test fails).
- Playwright: J1 step 1 shows set-up only, then Approved unlocks step 3.
- Security: ponytail-review, every capability endpoint covered, tenant isolation unchanged.
- Browser: English and Arabic, axe clean.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
